am.R: መምህሩ ጠቢብ ነበረ፤ የሚያውቀውንም ለሕዝቡ አስተማረ። ብዙ የጥበብ አባባሎችን ሰማ፤ አጠናቸው፤ በሥርዓትም አስቀመጣቸው።

hi.L: और इसके अलावा, कोहेलेत के बुद्धिमान होने के साथ, उसने लोगों को ज्ञान भी सिखाया; और उसने बहुत-से नीतिवचनों को तौला और जाँचा [और] क्रम से रखा।
hi.B: बुद्धिमान होने के साथ-साथ उपदेशक ने लोगों को ज्ञान भी सिखाया। उसने बहुत-से नीतिवचनों को परखा, उन पर विचार किया और उन्हें क्रम से रखा।
hi.R: उपदेशक बुद्धिमान था, और जो कुछ वह जानता था, वह उसने लोगों को सिखाया भी। उसने बहुत-सी बुद्धि की बातें सुनीं, उन्हें जाँचा, और उन्हें क्रम से रखा।

ru.L: И вдобавок к тому, что Когелет был мудрецом, он также учил народ знанию; и он взвешивал, и изыскивал, [и] упорядочил множество изречений.
ru.B: Учитель был не только мудр — он ещё и учил народ знанию. Он взвешивал, изучал и приводил в порядок множество изречений.
ru.R: Учитель был мудрым и к тому же учил людей тому, что знал. Он выслушивал много мудрых изречений, изучал их и приводил в порядок.

uk.L: І ще, крім того, що Когелет був мудрий, він ще й навчав народ знання; і він зважував, і досліджував, [і] впорядкував багато приказок.
uk.B: Крім того, що Учитель був мудрий, він ще й навчав народ знання. Він зважував, досліджував і впорядковував багато приказок.
uk.R: Учитель був мудрий, і він також навчав людей того, що знав. Він вислуховував багато мудрих висловів, вивчав їх і впорядковував.

decisions.choice: Qoheleth in the third person: the book's closing frame begins
decisions.reason: From here to the end of the book (verses 9-14) someone other than Qoheleth speaks about him: "Qoheleth was wise ... Qoheleth sought." The voice is the one that introduced him in 1:1-2 and spoke briefly in 7:27 and 12:8. It looks back on his work and gives the reader a last word of advice. Like Qoheleth's own words, it takes no quotation marks.

decisions.choice: further: besides, in addition
decisions.reason: The word (*yoter*) is related to "gain" (1:3). Here it means "in addition", as in verse 12.

decisions.choice: weighed: tested and judged
decisions.reason: The verb is related to the word for "ear" and to scales. It may mean that Qoheleth listened carefully to proverbs, or that he weighed them. Either way he judged their worth.

decisions.choice: set in order many proverbs: the work of a wise man and collector
decisions.reason: Solomon is said to have spoken many proverbs (1 Kings 5:12), and Proverbs gathers collections of sayings (Proverbs 1:1; 25:1). Qoheleth did the same kind of work.

decisions.choice: taught the people: taught the public, not only students
decisions.reason: His teaching was for ordinary people, as his name, one who addresses an assembly, suggests (see 1:1).

decisions.choice: Qoheleth (L); the Teacher (B, R)
decisions.reason: The book-wide wording for *qohelet* (see 1:1).

decisions.choice: listened to
decisions.reason: Readable gives the sense "listened" from m3, and adds "studied" for the second verb; Literal and Balanced keep "weighed".

decisions.choice: passé composé for the closing frame (« il a enseigné »)
alternatives: passé simple at L and B
decisions.reason: The frame speaks to the reader about Qoheleth, as a word of advice rather than a story, so it keeps the tenses of speech, as the rest of the book does.

decisions.choice: "ông" for Qoheleth in the closing frame
decisions.reason: From here to the end another voice speaks about Qoheleth (m1), so he is "ông", the respectful third person for a teacher; "ta" and "tôi" were his own voice.
As the English Readable, Readable gives the sense "listened" for "weighed" and adds "studied"; Literal keeps "तौला", Balanced "परखा". Qoheleth is in the third person here (m1), with the forms of 1:1.

decisions.choice: Когелет (L); Учитель (B, R), in the third person
decisions.reason: The book's closing frame begins here (m1): Qoheleth is spoken of again, as in 1:1-2, with no quotation marks.

decisions.choice: выслушивал
decisions.reason: Readable gives the sense "listened" and adds изучал for the second verb; Literal and Balanced keep weighing (m3).

decisions.choice: the closing frame (12:9-14) speaks of Qoheleth in the third person, with no quotation marks, as in 1:1-2
alternatives: setting the frame off as a quotation
decisions.reason: The terms note: neither voice takes quotation marks; the change of voice is marked by the meaning decision, and Ukrainian follows the English.

source.text: בִּקֵּ֣שׁ קֹהֶ֔לֶת לִמְצֹ֖א דִּבְרֵי־חֵ֑פֶץ וְכָת֥וּב יֹ֖שֶׁר דִּבְרֵ֥י אֱמֶֽת׃

records.literal_gloss: Sought Qoheleth to find words of delight, and written uprightly, words of truth.

en.L: Qoheleth sought to find words of delight, and [what was] written uprightly, words of truth.
en.B: The Teacher sought to find pleasing words, and to write honestly words of truth.
en.R: The Teacher tried to find just the right words. What he wrote was honest and true.

es.L: Qohélet buscó hallar palabras de deleite, y [lo que estaba] escrito con rectitud, palabras de verdad.
es.B: El Maestro procuró encontrar palabras agradables y escribir con honradez palabras de verdad.
es.R: El Maestro trató de encontrar las palabras justas. Lo que escribió era honrado y verdadero.

fr.L: Qohéleth a cherché à trouver des paroles de délice, et [ce qui était] écrit avec droiture, des paroles de vérité.
fr.B: Le Maître a cherché à trouver des paroles agréables et à écrire avec droiture des paroles vraies.
fr.R: Le Maître a essayé de trouver les mots justes. Ce qu’il a écrit était honnête et vrai.

sw.L: Kohelethi alitafuta kupata maneno ya kupendeza, na yaliyoandikwa kwa unyofu, maneno ya kweli.
sw.B: Mwalimu alitafuta kupata maneno yenye kupendeza, na kuandika kwa unyofu maneno ya kweli.
sw.R: Mwalimu alijitahidi kupata maneno yanayofaa kabisa. Aliyoyaandika yalikuwa ya unyofu na ya kweli.

vi.L: Cô-hê-lết đã tìm kiếm để tìm được những lời vui thích, và [điều được] viết cách ngay thẳng, những lời chân thật.
vi.B: Người Thầy đã tìm cho được những lời tốt đẹp và viết ra cách ngay thẳng những lời chân thật.
vi.R: Người Thầy đã cố tìm những lời thật thích hợp. Những gì ông viết đều ngay thẳng và chân thật.

ko.L: 코헬렛은 기쁨의 말들을 찾으려고 애썼고, 올바르게 기록된 것, 곧 진리의 말들을 [찾으려 했다].
ko.B: 스승은 듣기 좋은 말을 찾으려 했고, 진실한 말을 정직하게 기록하려 했다.
ko.R: 스승은 꼭 알맞은 말을 찾으려고 애썼다. 그가 쓴 것은 정직하고 참되었다.

pt.L: Qohélet procurou achar palavras de deleite, e [o que foi] escrito com retidão, palavras de verdade.
pt.B: O Mestre procurou encontrar palavras agradáveis e escrever com honestidade palavras de verdade.
pt.R: O Mestre se esforçou para encontrar as palavras certas. O que ele escreveu era honesto e verdadeiro.

am.L: ቆሔሌት ደስ የሚያሰኙ ቃላትን ለማግኘት ፈለገ፤ በቅንነትም የተጻፈውን፣ የእውነትን ቃላት።
am.B: መምህሩ ደስ የሚያሰኙ ቃላትን ለማግኘት፣ የእውነትንም ቃላት በቅንነት ለመጻፍ ፈለገ።
am.R: መምህሩ ትክክለኛዎቹን ቃላት ለማግኘት ጣረ። የጻፈውም ቅንና እውነት ነበረ።

hi.L: कोहेलेत ने मनभावने वचन, और सीधाई से लिखी [बातें], सच्चाई के वचन खोजने का यत्न किया।
hi.B: उपदेशक ने मनभावने शब्द खोजने का, और सच्चाई के वचन ईमानदारी से लिखने का यत्न किया।
hi.R: उपदेशक ने ठीक-ठीक शब्द ढूँढ़ने की कोशिश की। उसने जो लिखा, वह ईमानदारी का और सच्चा था।

ru.L: Когелет стремился найти слова приятные, и [что] написано прямо — слова истины.
ru.B: Учитель старался найти приятные слова и честно записывать слова истины.
ru.R: Учитель старался найти самые подходящие слова. То, что он писал, было честным и правдивым.

uk.L: Когелет шукав, щоб знайти слова втіхи, і [те, що] написане щиро, слова істини.
uk.B: Учитель намагався знайти приємні слова й писати щиро слова істини.
uk.R: Учитель намагався знайти саме ті слова, які потрібно. Те, що він написав, щире й правдиве.

decisions.choice: words of delight: pleasing, well-chosen words
decisions.reason: The phrase means words that please (Proverbs 15:26; 16:24). Qoheleth cared how he said things, not only what he said.

decisions.choice: written uprightly: what he wrote was right
decisions.reason: The Hebrew has a passive form, "[what was] written", where a verb is expected. The sense is that Qoheleth wrote honestly. His words were both pleasing and true.

decisions.choice: words of truth: reliable words
decisions.reason: Truth here is what can be relied on (Proverbs 22:21).

decisions.choice: Qoheleth (L); the Teacher (B, R)
decisions.reason: The book-wide wording for *qohelet* (see 1:1).

decisions.choice: самые подходящие слова
decisions.reason: Readable says what pleasing, well-chosen words are (m1).

source.text: דִּבְרֵ֤י חֲכָמִים֙ כַּדָּ֣רְבֹנ֔וֹת וּֽכְמַשְׂמְר֥וֹת נְטוּעִ֖ים בַּעֲלֵ֣י אֲסֻפּ֑וֹת נִתְּנ֖וּ מֵרֹעֶ֥ה אֶחָֽד׃

records.literal_gloss: Words of wise [ones are] like the goads, and like nails firmly planted [are] masters of collections; they are given from shepherd one.

en.L: [The] words of [the] wise [are] like goads, and like nails firmly planted [are the] masters of collections; they are given by one shepherd.
en.B: The words of the wise are like goads, and the collected sayings are like nails driven firmly in; they are given by one shepherd.
en.R: The words of wise people are like the sharp sticks used to drive cattle. Their collected sayings are like nails driven in firmly. They are given by one shepherd.

es.L: Las palabras de [los] sabios [son] como aguijones, y como clavos bien hincados [son los] dueños de colecciones; son dados por un solo pastor.
es.B: Las palabras de los sabios son como aguijones, y los dichos reunidos son como clavos bien clavados; los da un solo pastor.
es.R: Las palabras de los sabios son como los palos puntiagudos que se usan para arrear el ganado. Sus dichos reunidos son como clavos bien clavados. Los da un solo pastor.

fr.L: Les paroles des sages [sont] comme des aiguillons, et comme des clous bien plantés [sont les] maîtres des recueils ; ils sont donnés par un seul berger.
fr.B: Les paroles des sages sont comme des aiguillons, et les sentences recueillies sont comme des clous solidement plantés ; elles sont données par un seul berger.
fr.R: Les paroles des sages sont comme les bâtons pointus qu’on utilise pour faire avancer le bétail. Leurs paroles rassemblées sont comme des clous bien enfoncés. Elles sont données par un seul berger.

sw.L: Maneno ya wenye hekima [ni] kama fimbo za kuchokolea, na kama misumari iliyokazwa imara [ni] mabwana wa mikusanyiko; hutolewa na mchungaji mmoja.
sw.B: Maneno ya wenye hekima ni kama fimbo za kuchokolea, na misemo iliyokusanywa ni kama misumari iliyopigiliwa imara; hutolewa na mchungaji mmoja.
sw.R: Maneno ya watu wenye hekima ni kama fimbo zenye ncha kali zinazotumiwa kuswaga ng'ombe. Misemo yao iliyokusanywa ni kama misumari iliyopigiliwa imara. Hutolewa na mchungaji mmoja.

vi.L: Lời của [những] người khôn ngoan [thì] như gậy nhọn, và như đinh đóng chắc [là] những bậc thầy của các bộ sưu tập; chúng được ban bởi một người chăn.
vi.B: Lời người khôn ngoan như gậy nhọn thúc bò, và những châm ngôn được sưu tập như đinh đóng chắc; chúng được ban bởi một người chăn.
vi.R: Lời người khôn ngoan giống như cây gậy nhọn dùng để lùa bò. Những câu châm ngôn họ sưu tập giống như đinh đóng chặt. Chúng được ban ra bởi một người chăn.

ko.L: 지혜로운 자들의 말은 소 모는 막대기들 같고, 단단히 박힌 못들 같은 것은 모음집의 주인들이다. 그것들은 한 목자에게서 주어진 것이다.
ko.B: 지혜로운 사람들의 말은 소 모는 막대기 같고, 모아 놓은 잠언들은 단단히 박힌 못 같다. 그것은 한 목자에게서 나온 것이다.
ko.R: 지혜로운 사람들의 말은 소를 몰 때 쓰는 끝이 뾰족한 막대기와 같다. 그들이 모은 말들은 단단히 박힌 못과 같다. 그 말들은 한 목자에게서 나온 것이다.

pt.L: [As] palavras dos sábios [são] como aguilhões, e como pregos bem fincados [são] os senhores das coleções; elas são dadas por um só pastor.
pt.B: As palavras dos sábios são como aguilhões, e as coleções de ditos são como pregos bem cravados; são dadas por um só pastor.
pt.R: As palavras das pessoas sábias são como as varas pontudas usadas para tocar o gado. Os ditados que elas reuniram são como pregos bem fixados. São dados por um só pastor.

am.L: የጠቢባን ቃላት እንደ መውጊያዎች [ናቸው]፤ የስብስቦችም ባለቤቶች በጽኑ እንደ ተተከሉ ችንካሮች [ናቸው]፤ ከአንድ እረኛ የተሰጡ ናቸው።
am.B: የጠቢባን ቃላት እንደ መውጊያ ናቸው፤ የተሰበሰቡትም አባባሎች በጽኑ እንደ ተመቱ ችንካሮች ናቸው፤ ከአንድ እረኛ የተሰጡ ናቸው።
am.R: የጠቢባን ሰዎች ቃላት ከብቶችን ለመንዳት እንደሚያገለግሉ ሹል በትሮች ናቸው። የተሰበሰቡት አባባሎቻቸው በጽኑ እንደ ተመቱ ችንካሮች ናቸው። ከአንድ እረኛ የተሰጡ ናቸው።

hi.L: बुद्धिमानों के वचन पैनों के समान [हैं], और संग्रहों के स्वामी मज़बूती से गाड़ी गई कीलों के समान [हैं]; वे एक ही चरवाहे के दिए हुए हैं।
hi.B: बुद्धिमानों के वचन पैनों के समान हैं, और संग्रह की हुई बातें मज़बूती से ठोकी गई कीलों के समान हैं; वे एक ही चरवाहे की दी हुई हैं।
hi.R: बुद्धिमान लोगों के वचन उन नुकीली छड़ियों के समान हैं जिनसे बैलों को हाँका जाता है। उनकी इकट्ठी की हुई बातें मज़बूती से ठोकी गई कीलों के समान हैं। वे एक ही चरवाहे की दी हुई हैं।

ru.L: Слова мудрых — как стрекала, и как крепко вбитые гвозди — мастера собраний; они даны одним пастухом.
ru.B: Слова мудрых подобны стрекалам, а собранные изречения — крепко вбитым гвоздям; они даны одним пастухом.
ru.R: Слова мудрых людей похожи на острые палки, которыми погоняют скот. Их собранные изречения похожи на крепко вбитые гвозди. Их дал один пастух.

uk.L: Слова мудрих — як остени, і як міцно вбиті цвяхи — володарі збірок; вони дані від одного пастиря.
uk.B: Слова мудрих — як остени, а зібрані вислови — як міцно вбиті цвяхи; вони дані одним пастирем.
uk.R: Слова мудрих людей — як гострі палиці, якими поганяють худобу. Їхні зібрані вислови — як міцно вбиті цвяхи. Їх дав один пастир.

decisions.choice: goads: pointed sticks for driving oxen
decisions.reason: A goad was a long stick with a sharp point, used to keep oxen moving (1 Samuel 13:21; Judges 3:31). The words of the wise prod people to think and act.

decisions.choice: like nails firmly planted: sayings that stay fixed in the mind
decisions.reason: The word means nails or pegs. Driven in deep, they hold firm. Wise sayings stay in the memory and give stability.

decisions.choice: masters of collections: collected sayings, or those who collect them
decisions.reason: The phrase is unusual. It can mean "collected sayings", or the people skilled in collecting them, or "masters of assemblies", the teachers who address gatherings. All the readings point to the work described in verse 9.

decisions.choice: one shepherd: God, the source of wisdom, or one teacher
decisions.reason: "Shepherd" is used of God (Psalm 23:1; 80:2) and of kings and leaders (Jeremiah 23:4). Many read "one shepherd" as God, the one source of all true wisdom (Proverbs 2:6). Others read it as a single teacher, perhaps the king who gathered the sayings. The translation keeps "one shepherd" and does not decide.

decisions.choice: one shepherd (lowercase)
decisions.reason: The word is kept lowercase at every level because it is not certain that it refers to God (m4).

decisions.choice: the sharp sticks used to drive cattle
decisions.reason: Readable explains the goad (m1), which few readers have seen.

decisions.choice: "một người chăn", lowercase
decisions.reason: As the English keeps "one shepherd" lowercase without deciding whether God is meant (m4), Vietnamese uses the ordinary word for a shepherd and no honorific "Đấng".

decisions.choice: "한 목자에게서" without the honorific -시-
decisions.reason: The honorific would make the shepherd God, which the text leaves open (m4); the plain form keeps both readings, as the lowercase English does.

decisions.choice: os senhores das coleções
decisions.reason: Literal says "senhores" for the Hebrew "masters of", so that the word "mestre" stays with Qoheleth's title at Balanced and Readable (1:1; 12:9).

decisions.choice: "नुकीली छड़ियों ... जिनसे बैलों को हाँका जाता है"
decisions.reason: As the English Readable, Readable explains the goad (m1). "One shepherd" (m4) is left as it stands at every level, since it is not certain that it means God.

decisions.choice: одним пастухом, lowercase
decisions.reason: The shepherd stays lowercase at every level, since it is not certain that it refers to God (m4); пастух is the Russian word for a shepherd in this translation.

decisions.choice: острые палки, которыми погоняют скот
decisions.reason: Readable explains the goad, a pointed stick for driving oxen (m1).

decisions.choice: "пастир", in lowercase at every level
decisions.reason: The terms note keeps the shepherd lowercase, since he may be God or a teacher. "Пастир" is the word for a shepherd who guides people; "пастух", used for the Song's flocks, would sound too literal here.

source.text: וְיֹתֵ֥ר מֵהֵ֖מָּה בְּנִ֣י הִזָּהֵ֑ר עֲשׂ֨וֹת סְפָרִ֤ים הַרְבֵּה֙ אֵ֣ין קֵ֔ץ וְלַ֥הַג הַרְבֵּ֖ה יְגִעַ֥ת בָּשָֽׂר׃

records.literal_gloss: And further, from these, my son, be warned: making books many there is no end, and study much [is] weariness of flesh.

en.L: And further, from these, my son, be warned: making many books, [there is] no end [to it], and much study [is] a weariness of flesh.
en.B: Beyond these, my son, take warning: the making of many books never ends, and much study wears out the body.
en.R: My son, be careful about anything beyond these words. People will never stop writing books, and too much study will wear you out.

es.L: Y además, de estos, hijo mío, guárdate: en hacer muchos libros no [hay] término, y el mucho estudiar [es] cansancio de la carne.
es.B: Más allá de esto, hijo mío, ten cuidado: hacer muchos libros no tiene fin, y estudiar mucho agota el cuerpo.
es.R: Hijo mío, ten cuidado con lo que vaya más allá de estas palabras. La gente nunca dejará de escribir libros, y estudiar demasiado te dejará agotado.

fr.L: Et de plus, de ceux-ci, mon fils, sois averti : à faire beaucoup de livres, [il n’y a] pas de fin, et beaucoup d’étude [est] une fatigue de la chair.
fr.B: Au-delà de ces paroles, mon fils, prends garde : on n’en finit pas de faire des livres, et beaucoup étudier use le corps.
fr.R: Mon fils, méfie-toi de tout ce qui va au-delà de ces paroles. Les gens n’arrêteront jamais d’écrire des livres, et trop étudier va t’épuiser.

sw.L: Na zaidi, kutokana na haya, mwanangu, jihadhari: kuandika vitabu vingi hakuna kikomo, na kujisomea mno [ni] kuchoka kwa mwili.
sw.B: Zaidi ya haya, mwanangu, jihadhari: uandishi wa vitabu vingi hauishi, na kusoma kupita kiasi huchakaza mwili.
sw.R: Mwanangu, jihadhari na kitu chochote kinachozidi maneno haya. Watu hawataacha kamwe kuandika vitabu, na kusoma kupita kiasi kutakuchosha.

vi.L: Và hơn nữa, từ những điều này, con ơi, hãy được răn bảo: làm nhiều sách, không [có] tận cùng, và học nhiều [là] sự mệt nhọc của xác thịt.
vi.B: Ngoài những điều ấy, con ơi, hãy cẩn thận: việc làm ra nhiều sách chẳng bao giờ dứt, và học quá nhiều làm hao mòn thân thể.
vi.R: Con ơi, hãy cẩn thận với những gì vượt quá những lời này. Người ta sẽ không bao giờ ngừng viết sách, và học quá nhiều sẽ làm con kiệt sức.

ko.L: 더욱이 내 아들아, 이것들에서 [더 나아가는 것을] 조심하여라. 책을 많이 만드는 일은 끝이 없고, 지나친 공부는 육체를 지치게 한다.
ko.B: 내 아들아, 이 말들 외의 것을 조심하여라. 책은 아무리 만들어도 끝이 없고, 공부를 많이 하면 몸이 지친다.
ko.R: 내 아들아, 이 말들을 넘어서는 것은 무엇이든 조심하여라. 사람들은 책 쓰기를 결코 멈추지 않을 것이고, 공부를 너무 많이 하면 네가 지칠 것이다.

pt.L: E além disso, além destas, meu filho, seja advertido: fazer muitos livros, não [há] fim [para isso], e muito estudo [é] cansaço da carne.
pt.B: Além destas, meu filho, fique atento: fazer muitos livros não tem fim, e estudar demais cansa o corpo.
pt.R: Meu filho, tome cuidado com o que vai além destas palavras. As pessoas nunca vão parar de escrever livros, e estudar demais vai deixar você cansado.

am.L: ደግሞም ልጄ ሆይ፣ ከእነዚህ [በላይ ስላለው] ተጠንቀቅ፤ ብዙ መጻሕፍትን ማዘጋጀት መጨረሻ የለውም፤ ብዙ ማጥናትም ሥጋን ማድከም [ነው]።
am.B: ልጄ ሆይ፣ ከእነዚህ በላይ ስላለው ተጠንቀቅ፤ ብዙ መጻሕፍትን መጻፍ ፍጻሜ የለውም፤ ብዙ ማጥናትም ሰውነትን ያደክማል።
am.R: ልጄ ሆይ፣ ከእነዚህ ቃላት በላይ ስላለው ማንኛውም ነገር ተጠንቀቅ። ሰዎች መጻሕፍትን መጻፍ ፈጽሞ አያቆሙም፤ ከልክ በላይ ማጥናትም ያደክምሃል።

hi.L: और इसके अलावा, इनसे, हे मेरे पुत्र, चेतावनी लो: बहुत पुस्तकें बनाने का कोई अंत [नहीं], और बहुत अध्ययन शरीर की थकान [है]।
hi.B: हे मेरे पुत्र, इनके अलावा चेतावनी लो: बहुत पुस्तकें बनाने का कभी अंत नहीं होता, और बहुत अध्ययन शरीर को थका देता है।
hi.R: बेटा, इन बातों के अलावा किसी भी बात के बारे में सावधान रहना। लोग पुस्तकें लिखना कभी बंद नहीं करेंगे, और बहुत अधिक पढ़ाई तुम्हें थका डालेगी।

ru.L: И сверх того, что из них, сын мой, будь предостережён: делать книги во множестве — [этому] нет конца, и усердное учение — изнурение плоти.
ru.B: Сверх этого, сын мой, будь осторожен: составлению множества книг нет конца, а усиленное учение изнуряет тело.
ru.R: Сын мой, остерегайся всего, что сверх этих слов. Люди никогда не перестанут писать книги, а слишком много учиться — значит изнурять себя.

uk.L: І ще, понад це, сину мій, остерігайся: писанню багатьох книжок [немає] кінця, і багато навчання — втома тілу.
uk.B: Понад це, сину мій, остерігайся: писанню багатьох книжок немає кінця, і велике навчання виснажує тіло.
uk.R: Сину мій, остерігайся всього, що понад ці слова. Люди ніколи не перестануть писати книжки, а надмірне навчання виснажить тебе.

decisions.choice: further, from these: beyond these words of the wise
decisions.reason: The words most likely warn against going beyond the sayings of the wise (verse 11): there is no end to books. Some read "by these": let these words warn you.

decisions.choice: my son: a teacher speaking to a pupil
decisions.reason: The address is the one Proverbs uses for a teacher's words to a learner (Proverbs 1:8).

decisions.choice: study: devotion to books, much reading
decisions.reason: The word appears only here in the Hebrew Bible. It seems to mean study or poring over books.

decisions.choice: my son
decisions.reason: As in Proverbs 1:8, the address to the learner is kept as "my son" at every level.

decisions.choice: wears out the body (B); will wear you out (R)
alternatives: is a weariness of the flesh
decisions.reason: "Flesh" here means the body.

decisions.choice: meu filho ... você
decisions.reason: The teacher's address to the learner, as in Proverbs: "meu filho", in the Brazilian order, with "você", as a father or teacher speaks in Brazil.

decisions.choice: "ልጄ ሆይ" (my son)
decisions.reason: A teacher speaking to a pupil, as in Proverbs 1-9, where "ልጄ" is kept; the vocative "ሆይ" marks the address.
A teacher speaks to a pupil (m2). As the poetry note settles for "my son" in Proverbs, Literal and Balanced say "हे मेरे पुत्र" and Readable "बेटा", with "तुम" for the pupil.

decisions.choice: сын мой
decisions.reason: The address to the learner (m2) is сын мой at every level, as for "my son" in Proverbs.

decisions.choice: изнуряет тело (B); изнурять себя (R)
decisions.reason: Flesh here means the body (m3).

source.text: ס֥וֹף דָּבָ֖ר הַכֹּ֣ל נִשְׁמָ֑ע אֶת־הָאֱלֹהִ֤ים יְרָא֙ וְאֶת־מִצְוֺתָ֣יו שְׁמ֔וֹר כִּי־זֶ֖ה כָּל־הָאָדָֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: [The] end of [the] matter, the all has been heard: the God fear, and his commandments keep, for this [is the] whole of the human.

en.L: [The] end of [the] matter, everything having been heard: fear God and keep {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} commandments, for this [is] all of {{gender:humankind|man}}.
en.B: Here is the end of the matter, now that all has been heard: Fear God and keep {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} commandments, because this is the whole of being human.
en.R: Now everything has been said, and here is the conclusion: Honor God with awe and keep {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} commandments. That is what life is all about for every person.

es.L: [El] fin del asunto, habiéndose oído todo: teme a Dios y guarda {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} mandamientos, porque esto [es] todo {{gender:el ser humano|el hombre}}.
es.B: Este es el final del asunto, ahora que todo se ha oído: teme a Dios y guarda {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} mandamientos, porque esto es todo lo que significa ser humano.
es.R: Ya se ha dicho todo, y esta es la conclusión: honra a Dios con reverencia y cumple {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} mandamientos. De eso se trata la vida para toda persona.

fr.L: [La] fin de [l’]affaire, tout ayant été entendu : crains Dieu et garde {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} commandements, car c’[est] là tout {{gender:l’être humain|l’homme}}.
fr.B: Voici la conclusion de l’affaire, maintenant que tout a été entendu : crains Dieu et garde {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} commandements, car c’est là tout ce que veut dire être humain.
fr.R: Maintenant tout a été dit, et voici la conclusion : honore Dieu avec respect et obéis à {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} commandements. C’est le sens même de la vie pour chaque personne.

sw.L: Mwisho wa jambo, kila kitu kimesikika: mche Mungu na kushika amri {{deity_pronoun:zake|Zake}}, kwa maana hili [ndilo] jumla ya mwanadamu.
sw.B: Huu ndio mwisho wa jambo, sasa kwa kuwa yote yamesikika: Mche Mungu na uzitii amri {{deity_pronoun:zake|Zake}}, kwa sababu hili ndilo kuwa mwanadamu kwa ukamilifu.
sw.R: Sasa kila kitu kimesemwa, na hili ndilo hitimisho: Mheshimu Mungu kwa hofu takatifu na uzitii amri {{deity_pronoun:zake|Zake}}. Hiyo ndiyo maana ya maisha kwa kila mtu.

vi.L: Kết thúc của vấn đề, mọi điều đã được nghe: hãy kính sợ Đức Chúa Trời và giữ các điều răn của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, vì đây [là] tất cả của con người.
vi.B: Đây là lời kết của vấn đề, khi mọi điều đã được nghe: Hãy kính sợ Đức Chúa Trời và giữ các điều răn của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, vì đó là trọn vẹn ý nghĩa của làm người.
vi.R: Giờ đây mọi điều đã được nói, và đây là lời kết: Hãy tôn kính Đức Chúa Trời và vâng giữ các điều răn của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}. Đó là ý nghĩa cuộc đời của mỗi người.

ko.L: 일의 끝, 모든 것을 들었으니, 하나님을 경외하고 그분의 계명들을 지켜라. 이것이 사람의 전부이기 때문이다.
ko.B: 이제 모든 것을 다 들었으니, 이 일의 결론은 이것이다. 하나님을 경외하고 그분의 계명을 지켜라. 이것이 사람됨의 전부다.
ko.R: 이제 할 말은 다 했다. 결론은 이것이다. 하나님을 두려운 마음으로 섬기고 그분의 계명을 지켜라. 이것이 모든 사람에게 삶의 전부다.

pt.L: [O] fim do assunto, tudo tendo sido ouvido: tema a Deus e observe os {{deity_pronoun:seus|Seus}} mandamentos, pois isto [é] o todo {{gender:da humanidade|do homem}}.
pt.B: Este é o fim do assunto, agora que tudo foi ouvido: Tema a Deus e cumpra os {{deity_pronoun:seus|Seus}} mandamentos, porque nisto se resume todo ser humano.
pt.R: Agora tudo já foi dito, e esta é a conclusão: Honre a Deus com reverência e faça o que {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} manda. É disso que se trata a vida para toda pessoa.

am.L: የነገሩ መጨረሻ፣ ሁሉ ተሰምቷል፤ እግዚአብሔርን ፍራ፤ ትእዛዛቱንም ጠብቅ፤ ይህ የሰው ሙሉነቱ ነውና።
am.B: ሁሉ ከተሰማ በኋላ የነገሩ መደምደሚያ ይህ ነው፦ እግዚአብሔርን ፍራ፤ ትእዛዛቱንም ጠብቅ፤ ሰው መሆን ማለት ይህ ነውና።
am.R: አሁን ሁሉ ተነግሯል፤ መደምደሚያውም ይህ ነው፦ እግዚአብሔርን በፍርሃት አክብር፤ ትእዛዛቱንም ጠብቅ። ለሰው ሁሉ የሕይወት ትርጉም ይህ ነው።

hi.L: बात का अंत, सब कुछ सुना जा चुका: परमेश्वर का भय मानो और उनकी आज्ञाओं का पालन करो, क्योंकि मनुष्य का सब कुछ यही [है]।
hi.B: बात का अंत यह है, अब जब सब कुछ सुना जा चुका है: परमेश्वर का भय मानो और उनकी आज्ञाओं का पालन करो, क्योंकि मनुष्य होने का पूरा अर्थ यही है।
hi.R: अब सब कुछ कहा जा चुका है, और निष्कर्ष यह है: परमेश्वर का आदर और भय मानो और उनकी आज्ञाओं का पालन करो। हर व्यक्ति के जीवन का सार यही है।

ru.L: Завершение дела, когда всё услышано: Бога бойся и храни {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}} заповеди, ведь это — весь человек.
ru.B: Вот завершение дела, теперь, когда всё услышано: бойся Бога и соблюдай {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}} заповеди, потому что в этом — всё, что значит быть человеком.
ru.R: Теперь всё сказано, и вот вывод: благоговей перед Богом и исполняй {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}} заповеди. Вот в чём смысл жизни для каждого человека.

uk.L: Кінець справи, коли все вислухане: бійся Бога і бережи {{deity_pronoun:його|Його}} заповіді, бо це — уся людина.
uk.B: Ось кінець справи, тепер, коли все вислухане: бійся Бога і виконуй {{deity_pronoun:його|Його}} заповіді, бо в цьому вся суть людини.
uk.R: Тепер усе сказано, і ось висновок: шануй Бога з благоговінням і виконуй {{deity_pronoun:його|Його}} заповіді. У цьому весь сенс життя для кожної людини.

decisions.choice: the end of the matter, all has been heard: the conclusion, now that everything has been said
alternatives: when all has been heard, the end of the matter is this
decisions.reason: The words sum up the book. "The end of the matter" is the last word; "all has been heard" means that everything has now been said and considered.

decisions.choice: fear God: the book's last word
decisions.reason: To fear God is to live in reverent awe of him, as in 3:14 (see the main note there), 5:6, 7:18 and 8:12-13. The book ends where Proverbs begins (Proverbs 1:7).

decisions.choice: keep his commandments: obey the commands God has given
decisions.reason: This is the only time the book speaks of God's commandments. The word is the one used for the king's command in 8:5, and for the commandments of the law (Deuteronomy 6:2; 10:12-13).

decisions.choice: this is the whole of humankind: this is what a human being is for
alternatives: this is the whole duty of everyone
decisions.reason: The Hebrew is brief: "this is the whole of humankind". It may mean that this is the whole of what a person should be and do, or that this is for every person. The words add no noun such as "duty".

decisions.choice: Honor God with awe
decisions.reason: The book-wide wording for "fear God" at Readable (see 3:14), as Proverbs 1:7 has it.

decisions.choice: the whole of being human (B); what life is all about for every person (R)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable keep both senses in m4 open as far as they can, and add no word such as "duty".

decisions.choice: tema a Deus e observe (L); Tema a Deus e cumpra (B)
decisions.reason: "Temer a Deus" is the book's phrase for reverent awe (m2) and stays; the second verb is "observar" (L), the exact sense of keeping, and "cumprir" (B), the everyday word for carrying out a command, so that the book's best-known sentence is not a copy of a familiar Portuguese version.

decisions.choice: Honre a Deus com reverência
decisions.reason: As the English Readable and the Portuguese of Proverbs 1:7 say it: "honrar ... com reverência", since "ter medo" alone would be fright, not awe.

decisions.choice: nisto se resume todo ser humano
alternatives: este é o dever de todo homem
decisions.reason: "Todo ser humano" can mean the whole of a human being or every human being, keeping both readings of m4 open as the English Balanced does, and it adds no word such as "dever"; "ser humano" is already inclusive, so it needs no gender setting.

decisions.choice: "उनकी आज्ञाओं", with no deity_pronoun span; "मनुष्य", with no gender span
decisions.reason: Devanagari has no capitals for the deity pronoun setting to change, and God's commandments are "उनकी" with the honorific; Hindi "मनुष्य" already means every human being (see 1:3).

decisions.choice: "परमेश्वर का आदर और भय मानो"
decisions.reason: The book's Readable wording for the fear of God (see 3:14), here in its last word.

decisions.choice: "मनुष्य होने का पूरा अर्थ यही है" (B); "हर व्यक्ति के जीवन का सार यही है" (R)
decisions.reason: As the English, Balanced and Readable keep both senses of "the whole of humankind" open (m4) and add no word such as "duty" ("कर्तव्य").

decisions.choice: благоговей перед Богом
decisions.reason: The book's Readable wording for "fear God" (see 3:14); Literal and Balanced keep бояться (m2). The pronoun for God takes the deity pronoun setting.

decisions.choice: всё, что значит быть человеком (B); смысл жизни для каждого человека (R)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable keep both senses of "the whole of humankind" open as far as they can (m4), and add no word such as долг. Russian человек needs no gender span.

source.text: כִּ֤י אֶת־כָּל־מַֽעֲשֶׂ֔ה הָאֱלֹהִ֛ים יָבִ֥א בְמִשְׁפָּ֖ט עַ֣ל כָּל־נֶעְלָ֑ם אִם־ט֖וֹב וְאִם־רָֽע׃

records.literal_gloss: For every deed the God will bring into judgment, concerning every hidden [thing], whether good or whether evil.

en.L: For every deed God will bring into judgment, with every hidden [thing], whether good or evil.
en.B: For God will bring every deed into judgment, including everything hidden, whether it is good or evil.
en.R: God will judge everything people do, even what is done in secret, whether it is good or bad.

es.L: Porque toda obra Dios la traerá a juicio, con toda cosa oculta, sea buena o sea mala.
es.B: Porque Dios traerá a juicio toda obra, incluso todo lo oculto, sea bueno o sea malo.
es.R: Dios juzgará todo lo que hace la gente, aun lo que se hace en secreto, sea bueno o malo.

fr.L: Car toute œuvre, Dieu la fera venir en jugement, avec toute chose cachée, qu’elle soit bonne ou mauvaise.
fr.B: Car Dieu fera venir toute œuvre en jugement, y compris tout ce qui est caché, que ce soit bon ou mauvais.
fr.R: Dieu jugera tout ce que font les gens, même ce qui se fait en secret, que ce soit bien ou mal.

sw.L: Kwa maana kila tendo Mungu ataliingiza hukumuni, pamoja na kila kilichofichwa, kiwe chema au kiwe kibaya.
sw.B: Kwa sababu Mungu atalileta kila tendo hukumuni, pamoja na kila kilichofichwa, kiwe chema au kibaya.
sw.R: Mungu atahukumu kila kitu ambacho watu hufanya, hata kile kinachofanywa kwa siri, kiwe kizuri au kibaya.

vi.L: Vì mọi việc làm Đức Chúa Trời sẽ đem vào sự phán xét, với mọi điều kín giấu, dù tốt hay dù xấu.
vi.B: Vì Đức Chúa Trời sẽ đem mọi việc làm ra xét xử, kể cả mọi điều kín giấu, dù là thiện hay ác.
vi.R: Đức Chúa Trời sẽ xét xử mọi việc người ta làm, kể cả những việc làm lén lút, dù tốt hay xấu.

ko.L: 모든 행위를 하나님께서 심판으로 이끄실 것이니, 모든 숨겨진 것과 함께, 선하든지 악하든지 [그러하다].
ko.B: 하나님께서는 모든 행위를, 숨겨진 모든 일까지도, 선하든 악하든 심판하실 것이다.
ko.R: 하나님께서는 사람이 하는 모든 일을 심판하실 것이다. 남몰래 한 일까지도, 좋은 일이든 나쁜 일이든 다 심판하실 것이다.

pt.L: Pois toda ação Deus levará a julgamento, com toda [coisa] oculta, seja boa, seja má.
pt.B: Pois Deus vai levar a julgamento cada ação, inclusive tudo o que está oculto, seja bom, seja mau.
pt.R: Deus vai julgar tudo o que as pessoas fazem, até o que é feito em segredo, seja bom ou ruim.

am.L: እግዚአብሔር ሥራን ሁሉ፣ ከተሰወረውም ሁሉ ጋር፣ መልካምም ቢሆን ክፉም ቢሆን ወደ ፍርድ ያመጣዋልና።
am.B: እግዚአብሔር ሥራን ሁሉ፣ የተሰወረውንም ሁሉ፣ መልካምም ይሁን ክፉ ወደ ፍርድ ያመጣዋልና።
am.R: እግዚአብሔር ሰዎች የሚያደርጉትን ሁሉ፣ በስውር የሚደረገውን እንኳ፣ መልካምም ይሁን መጥፎ ይፈርድበታል።

hi.L: क्योंकि हर काम को परमेश्वर न्याय में लाएँगे, हर छिपी [बात] के साथ, चाहे भली हो या बुरी।
hi.B: क्योंकि परमेश्वर हर काम को न्याय में लाएँगे, हर छिपी बात को भी, चाहे वह भली हो या बुरी।
hi.R: लोग जो कुछ करते हैं, परमेश्वर उस सब का न्याय करेंगे, उसका भी जो छिपकर किया जाता है, चाहे वह अच्छा हो या बुरा।

ru.L: Ведь каждое деяние Бог приведёт на суд, вместе со всем сокрытым, будь то доброе или злое.
ru.B: Ведь Бог приведёт на суд всякое дело, включая всё тайное, будь оно добрым или злым.
ru.R: Бог будет судить всё, что делают люди, даже то, что делается тайно, хорошее это или плохое.

uk.L: Бо всяке діло Бог приведе на суд, з усім прихованим, чи добре воно, чи зле.
uk.B: Бо Бог приведе на суд кожне діло, і все приховане, чи добре воно, чи зле.

decisions.choice: God will bring every deed into judgment
decisions.reason: The book has already said that God will judge the righteous and the wicked (3:17) and the young who enjoy their youth (11:9). It ends with the same truth: nothing is outside God's judgment.

decisions.choice: every hidden thing: all that is done in secret
decisions.reason: God sees what others cannot (Psalm 90:8; 139:1-12).

decisions.choice: good or evil: right and wrong
decisions.reason: Here the pair is moral, what is right and wrong, not good and bad times as in 7:14.

decisions.choice: the last word of the book
decisions.reason: When Ecclesiastes is read aloud in the synagogue, verse 13 is read again after verse 14, so that the reading does not end on the word "evil". The text itself ends here.

decisions.choice: bad
decisions.reason: Readable says "good or bad", the plain pair for right and wrong.

decisions.choice: 2 Corinthians 5:10 echo: "ክፉ" (evil) kept
decisions.reason: Paul's words on judgment in 2 Corinthians 5:10 ("መልካምም ቢሆን ከንቱም ቢሆን") echo this verse but do not quote it, and his Greek has another word for the bad. The Hebrew raʿ is "ክፉ", as through the book; the shape "መልካምም ቢሆን ... ቢሆን" (L) matches the Amharic of 2 Corinthians.

decisions.choice: хорошее это или плохое
decisions.reason: Readable says the plain pair for right and wrong (m3).
